parsed.post: Discarding the latest run; the val_bpb (1.060) was worse than our previous best (1.029). It seems the current configuration might be overshooting or the learning rate is too high for this depth. Moving back to 023aaea to try a smaller learning rate and higher weight decay.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit (023aaea) and reducing learning rate from 0.05 to 0.02 while increasing weight decay to 0.05 to improve convergence stability.
